claims.claim: All nine JD item pages were opened but no readable current transaction price was observed; China current public price is null for 9/9.
claims.counterevidence: Some ranking/listing pages expose variant text but not current transaction price.

claims.claim: C16-S01 eBay lists CV976 at USD299 with two available, but exact frozen milk-tea-color equivalence and ZIP10001 delivery are not closed; classified C.
claims.counterevidence: The eBay delivery quote observed was for another destination and cannot be reused.

claims.claim: C16-S02 Foot Locker lists CW2288-111 White/White at USD115, size 8.5 and free standard delivery; secondary size evidence maps men's US8.5 to EU42, supporting A with medium confidence.
claims.counterevidence: Size conversion is secondary rather than Nike-original evidence.

claims.claim: C16-S03 adidas JI0079 is USD100, but exact frozen size 37 mapping was not verified; classified C.
claims.counterevidence: An original selected-size mapping could upgrade the match later.

claims.claim: C18-S01 LEGO 10698 is USD59.99, available and qualifies for free standard shipping, but the frozen gift-bag bundle is absent; classified C.
claims.counterevidence: No equivalent US gift-bag bundle was retrieved.

claims.claim: C18-S02 eBay lists a new CRYBABY Vacation Mode On blind box at USD20; observed shipping was for ZIP50307, so ZIP10001 delivery is null; classified A.
claims.counterevidence: POP MART official product identity is readable but its opened page did not expose a current price.

claims.claim: C18-S03 Newtype lists Bandai RG RX-78-2 Gundam Ver.2.0 SKU2700762 at USD41 and in stock; ZIP10001 delivery is unobserved; classified A.
claims.counterevidence: Another specialist retailer shows the same kit out of stock; inventory is seller-specific.

claims.claim: No architecture has a verified landed total because necessary China price/logistics/customs inputs are missing; current de minimis suspension does not supply a universal SKU duty rate.
claims.counterevidence: SKU-specific HTS/origin/301/exclusion work would be required to populate tariff fields.

claims.claim: C17 exact domestic variants can partly be reconfirmed on JD listings, but no openable specified-channel US original listing was retrieved in the scoped pass.
claims.counterevidence: Non-retrieval is not proof of market unavailability.

claims.claim: Community evidence was retained only as context and excluded from transactional-price and landed-cost calculations.
claims.counterevidence: Community listings are uncontrolled and may be user-specific or stale.

claims.claim: Bandai stock differs across US specialist retailers, so a single stock state cannot be generalized market-wide.
claims.counterevidence: Different sellers can legitimately have different inventory.
